name: 100x-visual-fission
description: Validation tooling for the 100x-visual-fission skill (VisualFissionBundle output contract). Not published -- this package.json exists only so scripts/validate.js can pull in ajv for real JSON Schema enforcement (structural checks: required/additionalProperties/enum/pattern/const/if-then-else), following the same ajv8 wiring as 100x-search-query. Cross-item/cross-field aggregate checks that JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express (identity-lock substring check, frame-count/array-length match, frame-sequence ordering, referential integrity, zero-orphan frame coverage, negative_prompt byte-equality, unvisualizable-claim word scan) stay hand-written in scripts/validate.js -- see that file's header comment and axioms.md.
